<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  html, body { height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #05060a; color: #e8ecf5;
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; user-select: none; }
  #game { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; touch-action: none; }
  .hidden { display: none !important; }

  /* ---------- Intro / pool select ---------- */
  /* block-level scroll container — reliably scrollable on mobile (flex+center clipped the pools) */
  #intro { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 40; overflow-y: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    text-align: center; padding: 20px 16px 96px;
    background: radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 50% -10%, #1b2a3f 0%, #080b12 60%, #04050a 100%); }
  #intro .title { display: block; }
  .title { font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 6px; font-size: clamp(38px, 9vw, 82px);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffb454, #ff7a18); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
    color: transparent; text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255,122,24,.35); }
  .sub { color: #8ea0bd; margin: 6px 0 4px; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .genbadge { display: inline-block; margin: 10px 0 16px; font-size: 13px; color: #cdd8ea; background: #10151f; border: 1px solid #23304a;
    padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 999px; }
  .genbadge b { color: #ffb454; }
  .namebar { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }
  .namebar input { background: #0d1119; border: 1px solid #26324a; color: #e8ecf5; padding: 10px 14px;
    border-radius: 10px; font-size: 15px; width: 200px; outline: none; }
  .namebar input:focus { border-color: #ff7a18; }
  #gate { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin: 6px 0 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }
  .cbtn { cursor: pointer; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 13px 22px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: .3px; color: #180a00; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffc766, #ff7a18); transition: transform .1s, filter .1s; }
  .cbtn:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .cbtn:active { transform: scale(.98); }
  .cbtn.ghost { background: transparent; color: #cbd6ea; border: 1px solid #2a3a58; font-weight: 600; }
  #walletStatus { font-size: 13px; color: #7CFC7C; min-height: 18px; margin-bottom: 12px; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; }
  .poolhead { font-size: 13px; color: #8ea0bd; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  #specBar { position: fixed; top: 66px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 22; pointer-events: auto;
    background: rgba(8,11,18,.82); border: 1px solid #2a3a58; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 8px 6px 16px; font-size: 12.5px;
    color: #cbd6ea; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
  #specBar button { cursor: pointer; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800;
    color: #180a00; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffc766, #ff7a18); }
  body.spectating #pad, body.spectating #atkBtn { display: none !important; }
  .devbtn { margin: 0 0 14px; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; border: 1px dashed #ff7a18; color: #ffb454;
    border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; }
  .devbtn:hover { background: rgba(255,122,24,.08); }
  /* multi-capture chooser */
  #chooser { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 55; display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(3,5,10,.8); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); padding: 18px; }
  #chooser .opt { cursor: pointer; width: 140px; background: #0d1119; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px; text-align: center; transition: transform .1s, border-color .1s; }
  #chooser .opt:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
  #chooser .opt canvas { width: 100%; height: 104px; }
  #chooser .opt .on { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 800; margin-top: 4px; }
  #chooser .opt .or { font-size: 10px; color: #8ea0bd; margin-top: 2px; }
  .pools { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(150px, 220px)); gap: 16px; max-width: 760px; margin: 14px auto; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) { .pools { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 12px; } }
